

```{r }
# ============================================================
# Load fusion data
# ============================================================
fusion_data <- fread(input_file)

# ============================================================
# Sanity check: raw input
# ============================================================
cat("========================================\n")
cat("SANITY CHECK: INPUT DATA\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("Total rows in input file:", nrow(fusion_data), "\n\n")
```


```{r }
# ============================================================
# Format chromosome names
# ============================================================
fusion_data$chrA <- ifelse(grepl("^chr", fusion_data$chrA),
                           fusion_data$chrA,
                           paste0("chr", trimws(fusion_data$chrA)))

fusion_data$chrB <- ifelse(grepl("^chr", fusion_data$chrB),
                           fusion_data$chrB,
                           paste0("chr", trimws(fusion_data$chrB)))

# ============================================================
# Keep valid chromosomes only
# ============================================================
valid_chroms <- paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X"))
before_chr_filter <- nrow(fusion_data)

fusion_data <- fusion_data[chrA %in% valid_chroms & chrB %in% valid_chroms]

after_chr_filter <- nrow(fusion_data)
removed_invalid_chr <- before_chr_filter - after_chr_filter

# ============================================================
# Filter only up/down-regulated fusions
# ============================================================
before_exp_filter <- nrow(fusion_data)

fusion_data <- fusion_data[exp %in% c("up-regulation", "down-regulation")]

after_exp_filter <- nrow(fusion_data)
removed_invalid_exp <- before_exp_filter - after_exp_filter

# ============================================================
# Stop if no data left
# ============================================================
if (nrow(fusion_data) == 0) {
  stop("No valid fusion events available after filtering.")
}

# ============================================================
# Count up/down regulation
# ============================================================
up_count <- sum(fusion_data$exp == "up-regulation", na.rm = TRUE)
down_count <- sum(fusion_data$exp == "down-regulation", na.rm = TRUE)
total_fusions <- nrow(fusion_data)

# ============================================================
# Check missing coordinates before simulation
# ============================================================
missing_startA <- sum(is.na(fusion_data$StartA))
missing_startB <- sum(is.na(fusion_data$StartB))
```


```{r }
# ============================================================
# Simulate coordinates if missing
# ============================================================
set.seed(42)
fusion_data$StartA <- ifelse(is.na(fusion_data$StartA),
                             sample(1e6:1e8, nrow(fusion_data), replace = TRUE),
                             fusion_data$StartA)
fusion_data$EndA <- fusion_data$StartA + 1000

fusion_data$StartB <- ifelse(is.na(fusion_data$StartB),
                             sample(1e6:1e8, nrow(fusion_data), replace = TRUE),
                             fusion_data$StartB)
fusion_data$EndB <- fusion_data$StartB + 1000

# ============================================================
# Print sanity check summary
# ============================================================
cat("========================================\n")
cat("SANITY CHECK: FILTERED DATA FOR PLOTTING\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("Rows before chromosome filtering:", before_chr_filter, "\n")
cat("Rows removed due to invalid chromosomes:", removed_invalid_chr, "\n")
cat("Rows after chromosome filtering:", after_chr_filter, "\n\n")

cat("Rows before expression filtering:", before_exp_filter, "\n")
cat("Rows removed due to non up/down expression:", removed_invalid_exp, "\n")
cat("Total number of Fusion:", total_fusions, "\n")
cat("Total number of Upregulated:", up_count, "\n")
cat("Total number of Downregulated:", down_count, "\n\n")

cat("Missing StartA coordinates simulated:", missing_startA, "\n")
cat("Missing StartB coordinates simulated:", missing_startB, "\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")
```


```{r }
exp_colors <- c(
  "up-regulation"   = "#E64B35",
  "down-regulation" = "#4DBBD5"
)

# ============================================================
# Create links table
# ============================================================
links <- data.frame(
  chr1   = fusion_data$chrA,
  start1 = fusion_data$StartA,
  end1   = fusion_data$EndA,
  chr2   = fusion_data$chrB,
  start2 = fusion_data$StartB,
  end2   = fusion_data$EndB,
  exp    = fusion_data$exp,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# Circos plotting function
# ============================================================
plot_fusion_circos <- function() {
  circos.clear()
  circos.par(track.height = 0.05,
             cell.padding = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
             gap.degree = 1)

  circos.initializeWithIdeogram(
    species = "hg38",
    chromosome.index = valid_chroms
  )

  for (exp_type in unique(links$exp)) {
    subset_links <- links[links$exp == exp_type, ]
    if (nrow(subset_links) == 0) next

    circos.genomicLink(
      region1 = subset_links[, c("chr1", "start1", "end1")],
      region2 = subset_links[, c("chr2", "start2", "end2")],
      col = exp_colors[exp_type],
      rou = 0.8,
      lwd = 1
    )
  }
}

# ============================================================
# Wrapper to draw plot + legend
# ============================================================
draw_full_plot <- function() {
  layout(matrix(c(1, 2), nrow = 1), widths = c(4.2, 2.8))

  # ---- Circos plot ----
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 1, 1))
  plot_fusion_circos()

  # ---- Legend panel ----
  par(mar = c(1, 0, 1, 2))
  plot.new()
  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = c("Up-regulation", "Down-regulation"),
    col = exp_colors,
    pch = 15,
    pt.cex = 1.8,
    cex = 1.4,
    title = "Fusion Expression",
    bty = "n"
  )
}

draw_full_plot()
```


```{r }
# ============================================================
# Save to PNG
# ============================================================
png(png_file, width = 2400, height = 1600, res = 300)
draw_full_plot()
dev.off()

cat("PNG saved to:\n", png_file, "\n\n")

# ============================================================
# Save to PDF
# ============================================================
pdf(pdf_file, width = 12, height = 8)
draw_full_plot()
dev.off()

cat("PDF saved to:\n", pdf_file, "\n")
```
